description:
Search Input Debounce Regression

A regression in the search input component is causing requests to fire on every keystroke instead of being debounced.

Your Task:

  • Fix the SearchInput component to debounce calls to onSearch.
  • The user input should be reflected immediately in the UI (controlled component).
  • onSearch should only be called after the user stops typing for the specified delay (default 300ms).
  • Use React hooks and avoid external libraries.
